title: An open immersion is of finite presentation exactly when it is quasi-compact
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

difficulty_reason: The lemma says that an open immersion is of finite presentation exactly when it is quasi-compact (statement lines 4192-4196). The counted proof is short and complete: open immersions are locally of finite presentation and immersions are separated hence quasi-separated, so by the definition of finite presentation the only remaining condition is quasi-compactness (proof lines 4198-4204). It is H2: the reductions are carried out in the counted span and the cited inputs are standard properties of immersions.
